subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Some said sealed phones look better and resist water.”?
options: Others said humans had not protected nature well enough with old rules.
Others said repairable products reduce waste and give users more control.
Another said clear size charts and customer reviews could reduce returns.
Anonymity can give people courage, but it can also reduce accountability.

本文可直接核對「Some said sealed phones look better and resist water. Others said repairable products reduce waste and give users more control.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Some said sealed phones look better and resist water. Others said repairable products reduce waste and give users more control.」，答案為「Others said repairable products reduce waste and give users more control.」。
